recipe.source: git archive 32a4f445 of https://github.com/aardappel/goose into build/goose-port/upstream-32a4f44/source-<variant>, then patch -p1 --fuzz=0 with compiler-goose/tools/upstream-32a4f44/series (new-patched: 01-11, new-precision: 01-17)
recipe.build: sh build/goose-port/upstream-32a4f44/build.sh <variant> "-DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-gline-tables-only -DGOOSE_EXPANSION_NODE_LIMIT=1000000 -DGOOSE_REACHABLE_PROGRAM=1": cmake -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/clang++ (clang 23.1.4) -DGOOSE_VERSION=32a4f44-<variant>; ninja goose; unpatched upstream used CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-gline-tables-only only
recipe.stdlib: each new build uses its own source-<variant>/stdlib (upstream 32a4f44 stdlib); old uses ../goose-to-wasm/build/source/stdlib

patches.note: StableCanContain/Reaches caches, global-root filter (root owners kept live: upstream components appear lazily), why-pointer TryMatch, bucketed ArrayReachVisited, export roots first, GOOSE_EXPANSION_NODE_LIMIT. Dropped its ApplyCalleeStores store-event key index: upstream cd988c4 remaps every body event afresh per call and drops caller-dependent sources, so "unrelated events are unchanged" no longer holds. ContentsReadBack static-only hunk moved to 17 (precision).
partial path also runs upstream CheckDefers
driver phase clocks re-added (upstream removed them)
IndexStoreEvent feeds only the holder index; v2 re-indexes a replaced event only when its container changes (upstream remaps every body event per call; re-recording each one cost ~48% of v1 time)
absent from the finite-root build; adapted to upstream MapClass shrinkexternals
upstream UsedAfter still lacks the frame skip
upstream NoteKill still skips globals (0357b1c covers locals only); controls 24/24
argcopy kept in upstream FnRecord::BodyEvent and threaded through holds(); RootAlt positional init fixed for upstream projected; controls 20/20
ContentsReadBack treats static-only contents as known

stdlib_drift.summary: No breakage. Imported stdlib modules: dictionary (unchanged), std, json, math. Signatures used keep their names; upstream marks small std/math/vec helpers checkfree, adds f32 math overloads and slice_pool/slot_pool modules, and moves json float helpers. The 451-file import closure parses, resolves and checks with the 32a4f44 stdlib.

selfhost.result: Cannot load compiler-goose: resolves a non-relative import against the importing file directory, then the stdlib, with lexical path normalization only. compiler-goose uses root-relative imports, so it stops after 897 "cannot resolve import" errors in 0.057s (96 MiB) before any type or borrow checking. No GOOSE_DIAGNOSTIC_ROOTS equivalent (no getenv in selfhost/).
selfhost.patch_correspondence: Independent 2.4k-line lifetime model; no shared code with the C++ checker or our patches. Its only checker speed commit, db76f45, hash-indexes its containment memo (life_contains), conceptually like our containment CanContain/ReachesThroughRefs caches and the holder/traversal bucket indexes; none of our C++ patches applies to it.

findings.speed: On the 17 roots that pass under both, new-precision-v2 takes 547.9s vs old 368.1s (1.49x); v1 took 1063.9s (2.89x). Pure upstream plus root selection is ~35x slower than new-patched-v2 on equal-error roots (assemble 222.5s vs 6.0s, record_artifact 272.9s vs 8.0s) and exceeds 300s on compile/check/prepare/semantic.
findings.memory: new-precision-v2 compile root peaks 8.84 GiB (old 6.20 GiB); the server root exceeds the 14G scope (goose anon RSS 14.6 GB about 180s in), where old fails at runtime_pipeline.goose:85 after 200s. Three heavy roots in parallel (--jobs 3) exceed 14G for old and new-precision; new-patched peaks 4.3 GiB per root.
findings.errors: new-precision-v2 first errors equal old on every root except server: compile runtime_pipeline.goose:85, emit core_eval.goose:1278; 17/20 pass. new-patched (no precision layers) adds code_expectation.goose:40, frozen_types.goose:36 (fixed by 17 contents-static-known, which the old containment patch carried silently), resolved_body.goose:70 and _diagnostic_roots.goose:119 (also reported by pure upstream and by old 2e2bedef without precision layers). No error is new to upstream 32a4f44.
findings.profiles: gdb sampling of the semantic root (profile/*.gdb.log): v1 spent 80% in ApplyCalleeStores and 48% re-recording the holder index for every remapped event (fixed in v2 08). v2 still spends 60% in ApplyCalleeStores; leaves ClassParam 12% and the remap loop 12%: upstream cd988c4 remaps every body event at every call, which the old containment key index skipped. Old spends its largest leaf in SaveFlow (17%), which upstream 7f421e9 narrows.

recommendation: Standardize on new-precision-v2 (upstream 32a4f44 + series 01-17) for diagnostics: identical first errors to the old checker on 19/20 roots, current upstream semantics, and a 2x improvement over the first port. It is still 1.5x slower and uses more memory than the old checker, and the server root needs more than 14G, so keep finite-root-diagnostics for server and time-critical repair loops until a cd988c4-compatible ApplyCalleeStores filter (remap only class-rooted events and callee-owned sources) and a per-call ClassParam memo recover the gap. That speed work belongs in our private patch series, not in goose-to-wasm: its self-hosted checker cannot load compiler-goose.
